notes.title: Demo Patch v.2.0
notes.content:
Tales of Frah'Akin Demo ver 2.0 patch is here! This patch brings smaller adjustments. Thank you for playing and happy gaming! 

ver.2.0 Patch Notes:

💢[Fixes] 
Combo skills have been adjusted.
Soft and hard locks have been fixed.
More "undefined" fixes.

🎮[Gameplay Updates]
Tweaked and enhanced a few story scenes.
Important events are now highlighted more.

💛 [Visuals]
Added a polished new opening animation.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.9
notes.content:
🛠️ Tales of Frah’Akin Demo ver. 1.9 – Patch Notes
A new demo update is here! Thank you so much for your patience and support. Version 1.9 introduces many gameplay tweaks, visual updates, and exciting new features. Enjoy exploring and happy gaming! 💚 

💢 [Fixes]
All localization issues (e.g. "undefined" text) have been corrected.
Note I is now visible when clicked.

💛 [Visuals]
New icons for Butter and Cheese.
The interactive stove icon now appears only after learning the Cooking skill.

🎵 [Sound]
Added custom sound effects for Ness, footsteps, and Cooking interactions.

🎮 [Gameplay Updates]
Cheese can now be found and picked up in some houses.
Adjusted the clothing change scene in Ennea’s Room.
Reworked the scene in Master Fennlisher’s house.
Added new tutorials covering Skill Learning, Combo Attacks, Exploration, and the Battle Command Window.
You can now pet the cats and dogs! 🐾
A smaller, early version of the World Map is now available to explore!

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.8
notes.content:
Tales of Frah'Akin Demo ver 1.8 patch is here! This patch brings bigger adjustments. Thank you for playing and happy gaming! 

ver.1.8 Patch Notes:

💢[Fixes] 
Combo skills have been adjusted and now don't work while the other character is either dead or not in the party.
Chess auto-battle has been temporarily removed until the mechanic gets fixed.

🎮[Gameplay Updates]
Aehlevander's skills have been adjusted.
Wolf Boss has been nerfed and now doesn't have supporting minions and a lower HP.
Bees have been nerfed and now have lower evasion.
New voice lines for King Kirstan!

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.7
notes.content:
Tales of Frah'Akin Demo ver 1.7 patch is here! This patch brings some small adjustments. Thank you and happy gaming! 

ver.1.7 Patch Notes:

💛 [Visuals]
The opening CG has been updated.

💢[Fixes] 
WASD movement has been fixed and is now working.
A few word misspellings have been adjusted.
Armor items are now displayed in Items.

📜[Credits]
Credits tab has been updated.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.5
notes.content:
Tales of Frah'Akin Demo ver 1.5 patch is here! This patch brings many graphical, audio, and gameplay adjustments as well as new features. Thank you for your patience and happy gaming! 

ver.1.5 Patch Notes:

💢[Fixes] 
The Polish translation has been refined and adjusted.

💛 [Visuals]
Some of the scenes have been adjusted.
Custom font in the Main Menu.
Updated battlers.
New battle animations.
Collectible plants and herbs are now highlighted.
New preloader animation.
Updated armor and accessory icons.

🎵 [Sound]
Added more custom music and sound effects.

🎮[Gameplay Updates]
Monster skills have been adjusted and balanced.
Added a new Quest System with pointers.
Added a Skill learning system.
Added a Tutorial System accessible from the Main menu.
Added a Teleporting System.
New houses are available to explore.
Included a new game mechanic - Cooking.
Added a new interactive minigame - Chess.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.4
notes.content:
Tales of Frah'Akin Demo ver 1.4 patch is here! This patch brings some performance adjustments, additional interactive content, a new mechanic, and a new enemy. Thank you for your patience and happy gaming! 

ver.1.4 Patch Notes:

💢[Fixes] 
Slightly improved the gaming performance on some of the maps.

💛 [Visuals]
Characters now have reflections on the water.
Added a custom cursor.
Collectible plants and herbs are now animated.

🎵 [Sound]
Added more custom music for several maps and some new sound effects.

🎮[Gameplay Updates]
Added a new forest monster - beetle.
Included a new game mechanic - jumping.
Added new interactive minigames - riddles.
Added a new side quest revolving around treasure hunting.
A short scene has been added after a failed battle.

notes.title: Demo Patch v1.3
notes.content:
Patch ver 1.3

Tales of Frah'Akin Demo ver 1.3 patch is here! This patch brings bug fixes, small adjustments, monster balancing, and new features. Thank you so much to everyone who’s provided feedback! 

ver.1.3 Patch Notes:

💢[Bug Fixes] 
Fixed a bug, where the speed lines reappeared during battle after opening Options.
Fixed all bugs related to the fishing mini-game.
Fixed visual bugs on maps with the cave and fountain.

💛 NPCs
A short scene was added after getting defeated by monsters in the forest (excluding the boss fight).
A short scene has been added following the events in the Throne Room at Amarath Castle.

🎮[Gameplay Updates]
New battle tutorial addition.
Monster skills have been adjusted and balanced.
Collectible herbs now appear as icons in the explorable map and compass and respawn when you re-enter a map.
The music mini-game has been shortened and made easier to play.
The balloons' position has been adjusted.
Compas and minimap are now enabled on all maps.
Once opened, treasure chests now disappear from the minimap and compass.
Adjusted more "undefined" descriptions.
Added 3 new crafting recipes: Potion, Antidote, and Magic Water.
After feeding cats and dogs the player now receives an MP Regeneration Orb or HP Regeneration Orb, which can be used in battle to apply the corresponding buffs.
Added a failed matches counter to the matching card mini-game.

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
Patch ver 1.1

Tales of Frah'Akin Demo ver 1.1 patch is here! This patch brings bug fixes and translation corrections, as well as new features in the demo. Thank you to everyone who’s reported bugs to me! 

ver.1.1 Patch Notes:

💢[Bug Fixes] 
Fixed a bug, where the game crashed after entering a map leading to Senersis' house.
Fixed a bug, where the game crashed during combat while using combo skills.

💛 NPCs
A new character interaction was added with a child playing the lute in the Forest Cave area.

🎮[Gameplay Updates]
A NEW boss fight was added in the Lost Forest!
